image_description: A close-up photograph of a young child blowing soap bubbles. The child is holding a bubble wand with a foamy, textured grip. A large, prominent bubble is forming at the child's mouth, exhibiting strong pink and white iridescence and specular highlights. Several other out-of-focus bubbles float in the background to the left. The lighting appears to be indoor flash photography, creating harsh reflections on the wet surfaces.
